tasks.title: Improve mobile layout
tasks.desc: Two rough spots on small screens: the hero stacks the photo above the bio, so the identity sits far from the text, and the navbar (brand + ULPGC badge + language toggle) gets cramped around 320-360 px width. Tighten the mobile layout so the hero reads as one compact unit (photo, name, role, socials, then bio) and the navbar keeps every control reachable without wrapping. Finished when the site at 360 px and 768 px shows no overflow, no wrapped or clipped labels, and the hero looks intentional on a phone rather than desktop-stacked.

notes.text: Tightened mobile layout across all sections: Section (py-12/px-4 on mobile), Hero (smaller photo 128px, tighter gaps), Teaching (p-4, gap-3, smaller icons), Publications (p-4, gap-2, smaller year badge), Projects (gap-4, p-4). Build clean. Check at 360px and 768px.
